entry.title: Cognitive Effects of Textual, Graphical, and Interactive Explanations in Explainable Artificial Intelligence
entry.summary: Examines how textual, graphical, and interactive explanation modalities shape cognitive processing, understanding, and user experience in explainable-AI systems.

entry.title: Human-Centered Explainable Artificial Intelligence and the Effects of Explanation Modalities on Trust, Understanding, and Decision Making
entry.summary: Investigates how explanation modalities influence trust, understanding, and decision making, placing human outcomes at the centre of explainable-AI evaluation.

entry.title: Dispersity Measures Within Sessions During Improvised Active Music Therapy with Clients with Parkinson’s Disease
entry.summary: Examines within-session dispersity measures in improvised active music therapy with clients with Parkinson’s disease.

entry.title: MidiPy: A Python Application for Processing MIDI Data in Improvised Active Music Therapy
entry.summary: Presents open-source Python research software for transforming MIDI event streams into reproducible measures and visual analytics for music-therapy research.

entry.title: Statistically-Guided Kernel Regression: Embedding Feature Relevance into Kernel Learning
entry.summary: Embeds statistically estimated feature relevance directly into kernel learning for regression.

entry.title: Any-Class Presence Likelihood for Robust Multi-Label Classification with Abundant Negative Data
entry.summary: Improves multi-label classification when datasets contain many examples in which none of the target classes is present.

entry.title: Conditional Denoising Diffusion Model for Missing Value Imputation in Smart Meter Data
entry.summary: Applies conditional denoising diffusion to reconstruct missing smart-meter observations in high-resolution energy data.

entry.title: Linear Lens: A Human-Centered, Non-Interventional Mechanistic Approach to Explainable AI
entry.summary: Introduces a non-interventional framework for tracing predictive information through neural networks and translating internal representations into human-centered evidence.

entry.title: Monotone Delta: An Order-Theoretic Tournament Graph Approach for Internal Consistency Assessment
entry.summary: Develops an order-theoretic tournament-graph method for assessing internal consistency in structured comparative settings.
